exposure: hemostatic compression sutures of the posterior uterine wall
cohort: A primiparous woman with posterior low-lying focal increta placentomegaly verified during cesarean section.
finding: Successful management of focal increta placentomegaly and uterine preservation was achieved in a primiparous woman through timely identification and adequate medical and surgical measures during cesarean section.
mod_finding: The focal increta placentomegaly was verified and managed during a cesarean section, which contributed to uterine preservation.
